Mond is the country in the game "genshin" and its spin-offs produced by miHoYo, located in the free city-state northeast of the Tiwat continent, and is a foreign country in the style of medieval Western Europe represented by Germany and the Netherlands. Between the mountains and the vast plains, the wind of freedom blows over the fruit wine lake with the breath of dandelions, sending the blessings and graces of Barbatos, the god of the wind, to Mond, located on the island in the heart of the lake.
Mond is surrounded by a lake of fruit wine on all sides, only a stone bridge connects with the outside world, and at the deepest part of the city is a magnificent church called the "West Wind Cathedral", and a statue of Bartos, the god of the wind, is erected in the square outside the church.
About 2600 years ago, the War of the Demons was not over, and the earth had not yet been classified as owned by the Seven Gods. At that time, Mond was in the brutal reign of Diego Calapian, the lone king of the tower, and a four-man squad composed of Barbatos, the god of the wind spirit, the boy, the red-haired knight, and the hunter girl led the insurgent army to overthrow the lone king of the tower, and the new god of the wind, Barbatos, was born. Barbatos fluttered the strings, blown the snow and ice with a kamikaze, and split the mountains. Barbatos, after bringing a new Mond to the Monds, left. Mond became a free, harmonious, kingless nation.
1,600 years after the founding of the city, a thousand years ago, Mond's "freedom" Into an unprecedented low point of terror. Barbatos, who had left because he did not want to be a tyrant, never imagined that the free-givers had made their own "people" The tyrant. Aristocrats led by the Lawrence family brutally ruled Mond, bringing slavery into the land, ignoring the cries of oppression.
God is back in the "capital of freedom". Together with the slave girl Winnesa, a revolution to overthrow the nobility. After the overthrow of brutal rule such as the Lawrence family, Winnesha led the Mond people to rebuild Mond City and establish a Knights of the West Wind in German politics, and since then Mond's nobles have lost their dominance, slavery has disappeared, and there are no slaves and slave owners.

Nasida is the manager of the void, the equivalent of the administrator of the Internet.

Rizuki, is the game "Original God" and its derivatives of the country, Tiwat mainland seven countries, located in the east of the mainland of the rich country, is the ancient Chinese style of foreign countries. Its commercial port, Glass Moon Port, is the most prosperous and throughput port in the whole continent of Tiwat, inspired by the ancient city of Phoenix and the suspended temple.
The "Golden House" of Glass Moon is the only mint in the whole continent of Tiwat, producing the unified currency of the whole continent, "Mora". The gods believed by the people of Rizuki are the "contract" in the "seven rulings of the earth". Morax, the god of the rock, has the title of "City of Contract".

Glass Moon is located in the east of Tiwat mainland, with a large land area, rich products, vast territory, complex terrain and climate types. There is the port of Rizuki, known as the capital of trade. The proud foothills and stone forests, vast plains and vibrant river beaches together constitute the rich landform of the glazed moon, radiating colorful scenery in the four-season climate, and also the most intense place of the war between demons and gods. Between the wonders of the mountains and stones, the ancient gifts of the demon god of endless rocks are waiting for people to discover.

Yunyan, Shenhe, Ganyu are all glazed moon people, living in glazed moon.

Sumiya is the country in the game "Original God" and its derivatives, located in the west-central part of the Tiwat mainland, the west side of the glaze moon, is a country of grass and trees, but also the Middle East style of foreign countries. Sumi is divided into rainforest and desert, the desert is located in the west and north of Sumi, known as the Great Chisha Sea and desert soil. Sumi is the kingdom of wisdom, and the search for wisdom and knowledge is never-ending.

The former grass god of Sumitsu was the king of the great mercy tree. The legacy of the Great Mercy Tree King is operated by the heart of God and is called Void. Systems that use knowledge as a resource to manage. The current grass god is "Maha good law great auspicious wisdom master" Bouyer.

Sumi is the capital of the school city in the midwestern part of the Tiwat continent, a strange country with lush rainforests and barren sand, where countless fruits of wisdom grow and bury. Whether it is crossing the jungle to step on the steps of the school city, or digging deep into the desert to dig the remains of terracotta, travelers from far away can gain valuable knowledge here.

Dishia lives in the desert of Sumi.

Fontaine, the country in the game "The Original God" and its derivatives, the source of the mainland water system, one of the seven countries of Tiwat, known as the "land of justice". Located in the middle of the Tiwat continent, it is an exotic country in the style of Britain and France. God was in charge of "justice." Fucarus, the god of water.

Fontainebleau is a country in the Tiwat continent named after the French commune of Fontainebleau and ruled by Faucarus, the god of water. Fontaineans have the ultimate pursuit of art, fashion, justice, with the most developed light industry technology in the seven countries of Tivat, Tivat mainland well-known newspaper "Steam Bird" headquarters is also located in Fontaine.
Fontaine is an earthly sea located in the middle of Tiwat. Follow the direction of the water Chunchun flow, across the fields, deep forests and sand sea, will arrive at the source of the mainland water system. Deep in the sea at the top of the waterfall and above the plateau, stories never heard and legends long forgotten are eager for tourists like lost countries that sink to the bottom of the water.
The Fontaine region has vast waters, diving into the water, not only to experience being surrounded by diverse creatures, but also to seem to have many treasures and unknown stories. As a land of water, Fontaine's underwater scenery can be described as magnificent, but not everyone can get a ticket to the underwater world. Even for those who have mastered the basics, diving is still an adventure with fun and challenges.
Pure water elves are relatives of the water from Fontaine, once distributed in the mountains and rivers of the whole continent of Tiwat, small pools and streams, most of them are Fontaine's spies. With the disappearance of the water god, many pure water elves cut off contact with Fontaine. Lotia is the most famous and powerful of the spies, but with the thought of the last water god, defected from Fontaine.
